{{Youmay|a starship|[[Sele (Cathar)|Sele]] the Cathar}}
[[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] '''Sele''' was an [[Airam (group)|Airam]] starship. Present as defense at [[Goff Platform|''Goff'']] space platform during [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance's]] attack there, it sought to engage [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] but was soon destroyed.
